visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single featured-story row with a large rounded image on the left and eyebrow, heading, lead and button on the right
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two fixed columns side by side on desktop (image | text), stacked on mobile; never wraps into a grid
visualCharacteristics.description: Warm beige section band. Rounded image left; orange tag pill, uppercase h2, grey lead paragraph and dark filled 'Read the Story' button right.

contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: [image] [eyebrow paragraph, H2, lead paragraph, bold CTA link]
rows: Eyebrow paragraph, H2, paragraph, CTA link
contentPattern.notes: The image cell is detected wherever it sits; the paragraph directly before the heading is the eyebrow. The section band colour comes from Section Metadata (style: secondary).

usage.description: Featured Article section on the WKND Adventures homepage.

reuseGuidance: Use for one highlighted story or promo with image beside text. For repeating items use a cards variant instead.
